source.method: Word-by-word review by Claude (November 2026); no automatic links

1:7.note: Reordered: "beginning of wisdom is fear of the Lord" (cf. Ps 111:10); plus "but".

1:13.note: "precious wealth" rendered "his wealth and his honour".

1:17.note: "in the eyes of" not rendered; "for the birds".

1:19.note: Plus "are"; "takes the souls of their owners".

1:27.note: Part of 1:27a (devastation, "suddenly") drawn into 1:26. Begins with 1:27b ("and your calamity like a whirlwind").

1:32.note: Plus "this"; shalvah rendered "error"; "lacking understanding" for fools.

2:16.note: Plus "wisdom" as subject; one adjective for zarah/nokhriyyah.

2:18.note: Free (cf. LXX): 'she forgot the thresholds of her house and the ways of her paths'; ways+paths both for מעגלתיה; death/shades not rendered; 'thresholds' plus.

3:2.note: "peace" moved to start of Syriac 3:3. Begins with "peace" from 3:2; plus "but".

3:4.note: "good understanding" rendered "kindness and understanding"; "men" as "sons of men".

3:5.note: "your understanding" rendered "the wisdom of your soul".

3:7.note: Plus "but"; "your eyes" as "eyes of your soul".

3:12.note: "as a father who chastises his son" for "as a father the son he delights in".

3:21.note: "sound wisdom" rendered "my teaching and my counsel".

3:27.note: "from its owners" not rendered; plus "to do".

3:28.note: Final clause "when you have it" moved forward; ketiv/qere re'akha.

3:32.note: "the devious" rendered "the wicked"; plus "of the Lord".

3:34.note: "he overturns the scoffers, and on the wise he has compassion"; anavim rendered "wise".

4:4.note: Plus "and my law as the apple of the eye" (from 7:2).

4:8.note: "embrace her" moved; ki not rendered; "prize her" rendered "love her".

4:15.note: "avoid it" paraphrased "in the place where they dwell"; plus "but".

4:16.note: "until they do evil... until they do their will".

4:26.note: "weigh the path" rendered "remove your foot from evil paths" (cf. 4:27).

5:4.note: La'anah rendered with a bitter plant; plus copula and "for".

5:9.note: "to the cruel" rendered "to those who show no mercy".

5:11.note: "you will groan" rendered "your soul will groan"; "your end" as "your old age".

5:16.note: "in your streets" for "outside"; "flow" for channels of water.

5:17.note: "there are none for strangers" rendered "strangers shall not share with you".

5:19.note: dadeha read as "her ways"; tamid not rendered.

5:20.note: "why" rendered as prohibition; plus "and also not".

6:2.note: Second "words of your mouth" rendered "speech of your lips".

6:3.note: As LXX: רעך doubly rendered ('on account of your friend ... into the hands of your enemy'); ܓܪܓ = רהב only, לך התרפס minus; plus 'therefore', 'for whom you stood surety'.

6:6.note: Vocative "sluggard" not rendered; plus "it has no harvest" (uncertain).

6:7.note: asher not rendered; officer/ruler as "one who compels".

6:10.note: "folding of hands" rendered "put your hand on your breast"; lishkav not rendered.

6:11.note: kimhallekh not rendered; plus "upon you" and "overtake you".

6:19.note: Reordered: "a false witness who speaks lies".

6:22.note: Expanded paraphrase; "when you lie down" not rendered.

6:24.note: "smoothness of tongue" rendered "slander of her tongue".

6:25.note: Doublet plus "be not caught by her eyes".

6:32.note: Plus "but" and copula; 6:32 end moves to S 6:33. Begins with end of MT 6:32; nega' not rendered.

6:33.note: Begins with end of MT 6:32; nega' not rendered.

6:34.note: Restructured: "for the wrath of a man is full of jealousy".

7:7.note: "I perceived among the sons a youth" condensed.

7:10.note: "behold" rendered "went out"; "guarded of heart" rendered "who steals the hearts of youths".

7:22.note: pitom read as "like a simpleton"; "anklet" rendered "dog"; ewil not rendered.

7:23.note: Plus "like a stag" (cf. LXX); "to death he goes".

7:27.note: "Her house is the ways of Sheol"; plus "ways" and copula.

8:1.note: halo rendered "therefore"; "gives her voice" rendered "will answer you".

8:3.note: qaret read as "calling"; plus "of the cities".

8:9.note: Expanded with pronouns and relative clauses.

8:10.note: Ethical dative with נבחר; comparative ܛܒ ܡܢ for מ of מחרוץ.

8:11.note: Plus 'better than refined gold' (from 8:10/19); 'better than precious stones' all for מפנינים; copula plus.

8:14.note: "I am understanding" rendered "mine is understanding"; plus copulas.

8:22.note: qanani rendered "created me"; me'az not rendered; plus "all".

8:30.note: "I was his delight" rendered "he rejoiced in me".

8:35.note: "whoever finds me" read as "my goings-out are goings-out of life".

9:3.note: "maidens" rendered "servants"; qaret not rendered; plus "and say".

9:6.note: "forsake the simple" rendered "leave your lack of understanding".

9:12.note: Plus 'my son', 'and for your friends', 'your evils'; long plus (LXX 9:12a-c) on chasing winds and birds.

9:18.note: As LXX: 'giants (רפאים) perish with her (שם)'; first pass was shifted by one from here; 'in the depth of Sheol' = 6,7; 'all who meet her' = קראיה; long plus (LXX 9:18a-d) starts with ܐܠܐ.

10:1.note: Heading "Proverbs of Solomon" not rendered; "fool" as "lacking understanding".

10:4.note: "slack palm" not rendered; "poverty humbles a man".

10:10.note: Second half replaced by "he who reproves openly makes peace" (cf. LXX).

10:13.note: Plus "strikes"; "rod for the back" rendered "with a rod strikes".

10:24.note: "fear of the wicked" rendered differently; "hope is given to the righteous".

10:25.note: Expanded: "suddenly", "so shall perish", "his foundations are laid".

11:12.note: Plus copula; "keeps silent" rendered "dwells in silence".

11:16.note: Plus "for a man" and LXX doublet on throne of shame and sluggards; osher rendered "knowledge".

11:21.note: "hand to hand" rendered "who stretches his hand against his neighbour".

11:24.note: Expanded as LXX ('his own'); 'gathers what is not his' for חושך מישר (uncertain); 'it is little to him' for למחסור; עוד/אך free.

11:26.note: "the people curse" rendered "leave him to his enemies".

11:29.note: Doublet: first half rendered twice ('who builds his house ... leaves sighs to his sons' / 'who is not quiet in his house apportions winds to his sons'); both linked; 'to his sons' plus.

11:30.note: "the wise takes souls" rendered "souls of the wicked perish" (cf. LXX).

12:2.note: "obtains favour" rendered "who keeps the will of the Lord".

12:4.note: Expanded simile "like a moth and worm in wood, so the woman who does evil destroys a man".

12:10.note: "compassion of the wicked is cruel" rendered "the wicked withhold their compassion".

12:12.note: "net of evil" rendered "to do evil"; plus "to do".

12:16.note: "on the same day" rendered "in his day"; reordered.

12:19.note: la'ad not rendered; ve'ad read as "and a witness".

13:4.note: Free: "always in desires is the man who does not work"; "and has nothing" not rendered.

13:6.note: "wickedness overthrows the sinner" rendered "his sin destroys the sinner".

13:10.note: raq not rendered; plus "an evil man".

13:11.note: "from vanity" rendered "from iniquity"; "by hand" rendered "in righteousness".

13:12.note: Plus "better is a man who begins to help than"; "heart-sickness" not rendered.

13:13.note: Long plus (LXX 13:13a) on the deceitful man and the wise.

13:22.note: S 13:22 includes an LXX-like rendering of 13:23 ("many years... men perished utterly").

13:23.note: S 13:22 includes an LXX-like rendering of 13:23 ("many years... men perished utterly").

14:7.note: As LXX: לך read as כל ('everything is contrary to a foolish man'), ובל ידעת read as וכלי דעת ('weapons of knowledge'), שפתי דעת = 'lips of the wise'.

14:8.note: "folly of fools" rendered "way of fools"; mirmah as "error".

14:9.note: Plus on houses of the wicked and righteous; "fools commit sins, the sons of the upright have favour".

14:12.note: "straight before a man" rendered "which men think straight".

14:22.note: LXX-type doublet: second half rendered twice ('the merciful and righteous do all good' / 'mercy and faith are with doers of good'), both linked; negative middle line plus; הלוא not rendered.

14:23.note: Plus 'one thing'; long plus (cf. LXX) on rest and the Lord healing pain; plus 'of the wicked'.

14:30.note: "a calm heart is life of the flesh" rendered "he who calms his wrath heals his soul".

14:35.note: Doublet of 14:32 inserted; "wrath destroys even the wise" (cf. LXX 15:1a).

15:4.note: Second half replaced by "whoever eats of its fruit is satisfied".

15:10.note: "him who forsakes the way" rendered "those who do not know"; plus "is evident".

15:20.note: adam not rendered; "despises" rendered "is a shame".

15:22.note: "without counsel" rendered "those who honour the assembly".

15:27.note: "troubles his house" rendered "destroys his soul"; "gain" rendered "bribe".

16:2.note: "spirits" rendered "his way"; "his eyes" as "eyes of his soul".

16:4.note: lema'anehu rendered "for those who obey him"; plus "is kept".

16:5.note: "hand to hand" rendered "who stretches his hand against his neighbour"; plus "from evil".

16:11.note: "stones of the bag" rendered "weights of truth".

16:19.note: "with the humble" rendered "humble of eyes"; "proud" rendered "mighty".

16:25.note: "straight before a man" rendered "seems straight in men's eyes".

16:26.note: "his mouth urges him" rendered "from his own mouth destruction comes".

16:33.note: Plus "of the wicked" and "comes forth"; kol not rendered.

17:4.note: "the righteous does not listen" (cf. LXX); sheqer not rendered.

17:8.note: hashochad not rendered; "stone of favour" rendered "precious stone of love".

17:10.note: "a hundred blows" rendered "a fool beaten does not feel".

17:12.note: "meet a bereaved bear" rendered "anxiety and fear fall on a wise man".

18:1.note: Free: "in his seclusion he plots desires and scorns good teaching".

18:2.note: "his heart" as object of thought; plus "in folly".

18:3.note: Plus "into the depth of evils... upon him"; gam not rendered.

18:19.note: nifsha' read as "helped" (cf. LXX); plus "by his brother".

18:22.note: Plus "good" wife and LXX 18:22a on him who casts out a good wife.

18:24.note: Free: "there are friends who are friends, and there is a friend who cleaves more than a brother".

19:1.note: "perverse of lips, a fool" rendered "a rich man who perverts his ways".

19:6.note: re'a read as ra' "evil"; le'ish not rendered.

19:14.note: maskalet not rendered; "a woman is betrothed to a man".

19:19.note: גדל read as גבר ('a wrathful man'); כי אם תציל paraphrased 'and as much as he ...'; plus 'to his burden'.

19:27.note: "cease to hear... to stray" rendered "cease, and hear... and do not stray".

19:29.note: "back of fools" rendered "people of the fool".

20:4.note: yacharosh read as "be silent"; ketiv/qere; plus "water".

20:14.note: "bad, bad says the buyer" rendered "a friend says to his friend: I bought".

20:24.note: "how can he understand" rendered "who is the man who directs".

21:1.note: Plus comparison "like"; kol not rendered; YHWH rendered "God".

21:2.note: Plural "ways"; "his eyes" as "eyes of his soul".

21:5.note: "diligent... hasty" rendered "faithful... evil"; ach (twice) not rendered.

21:6.note: hevel nidaf rendered "they are swept to destruction".

21:14.note: "bribe in bosom" rendered "he who refrains from giving stirs wrath" (cf. LXX).

21:17.note: "man of want" rendered "one who is lacking"; second ohev not rendered.

22:3.note: "the clever sees the evil one punished and is instructed" (cf. LXX); ketiv/qere.

22:10.note: Plus (LXX 22:10b) "for if he sits in the assembly he disgraces all".

22:20.note: Ketiv/qere shilshom/shalishim rendered "three times"; "counsels and knowledge" moved to S 22:21. Begins with end of MT 22:20.

22:23.note: "rob those who rob them" rendered "avenge the plunder of their souls".

22:26.note: 'Do not give yourself to suretyship'; משאות not rendered; plus 'for you will be ashamed before faces' (cf. LXX).

23:4.note: "do not toil to be rich" rendered "do not approach a rich man; with wisdom separate from him".

23:6.note: "bread of the evil eye" rendered "envious man"; ketiv/qere tit'av.

23:7.note: sha'ar read as "swallowing a hair/pitch"; "he says to you" not rendered.

23:19.note: "guide your heart in the way" rendered "rejoice in my counsel in your heart".

23:20.note: Plus "and do not be"; lamo not rendered.

23:28.note: "like a robber she lies in wait" rendered "suddenly she destroys"; af hi not rendered.

23:30.note: Long plus "be not drunk with wine but talk with righteous men" (cf. LXX 23:31).

23:31.note: "walks smoothly" rendered "meditate in righteousness"; ketiv/qere kos.

23:34.note: "on top of a mast" rendered "a sailor in a great storm".

23:35.note: Plus "and you say"; od not rendered.

24:5.note: Comparative "better is the wise than the strong" (cf. LXX).

24:10.note: "if you faint... your strength is small" rendered "evil drives the wicked in the day of distress".

24:12.note: hen and zeh not rendered; "hearts" rendered "thought of the heart".

24:26.note: "who gives right answers" rendered "those who reprove".

24:33.note: "folding of hands" rendered "put your hand on your breast"; lishkav not rendered.

25:10.note: "your infamy not turn back" rendered "many think about you".

25:13.note: Expanded simile "as snow that falls... cools heat, so".

25:22.note: Plus "when you do these to him"; "coals of fire".

25:23.note: tsafon rendered "north wind"; plus comparison particles.

26:2.note: "swallow" rendered "winged creature"; ketiv/qere lo not rendered.

26:3.note: Plus "so also"; "back of fools" rendered "foolish man".

26:5.note: "according to his folly" rendered "according to your wisdom".

26:6.note: "cuts off feet" rendered "from under his foot".

26:7.note: Free: "if you give walking to the lame".

26:10.note: Free (cf. LXX): "the flesh of fools suffers much, and the drunkard crosses the sea".

26:17.note: Reordered: "who meddles in a quarrel not his own is like one who seizes a dog's ears".

27:9.note: "sweetness of his friend" rendered "he who gladdens his friend"; plus comparison particles.

27:11.note: "answer him who reproaches me" rendered "remove from me the reproach".

27:14.note: "it is counted a curse" rendered "is not distinguished from one who curses".

27:16.note: tsafan read as "north"; shemen read as shem "name".

27:19.note: "as in water face to face" rendered "as faces are not like faces, so hearts".

27:21.note: Plus (LXX 27:21a) on the hearts of the wicked and upright.

27:22.note: As LXX 'in the midst of the assembly' for בתוך הריפות; mortar and pestle minus; plus 'you profit him nothing'; מעליו minus.

27:26.note: "price of a field" rendered "for your food".

27:27.note: "and life for your maidens" not rendered.

28:1.note: Plural 'the wicked'; plus 'when' and 'them'; 'like a lion' for 'like a young lion'.

28:4.note: Relative constructions with 'those'; 'strengthen themselves' for 'contend with them'.

28:6.note: 'Better' omitted; 'rich' moved before 'perverse in his ways'.

28:8.note: Ketiv/qere both rendered; 'they will leave it' for 'he gathers it'.

28:9.note: Plus copula; 'so as not to hear' renders 'from hearing'.

28:11.note: 'Rich man' fronted; 'in the eyes of his soul'.

28:12.note: 'Strength' for 'exulting'; 'is diminished' for 'men are searched for'; 'man' omitted.

28:13.note: Plus 'son of man', 'his sins', 'from them', 'on him God'.

28:20.note: 'The wicked in his iniquity' paraphrases 'he who hastens to be rich'.

29:1.note: Plus 'who does not accept'; 'reproof' as object.

29:4.note: 'Wicked man' for 'man of contributions'; 'diminishes it' for 'overthrows it'.

29:6.note: 'Is snared' renders 'snare'; order of first clause changed.

29:10.note: 'The righteous love him' for 'the upright seek his life'.

29:11.note: 'All his anger' for 'all his spirit'; 'considers in his mind'.

29:17.note: 'Will delight your soul' paraphrases 'give delights to your soul'.

29:18.note: 'In the multitude of the wicked' for 'without vision'.

29:19.note: 'Knows but does not heed' (free rendering of 'no answer').

29:20.note: Plus 'if' and 'know that ... is better'; 'hope' not rendered.

29:21.note: Passive 'he who is pampered from youth will be a slave'.

29:23.note: 'His humility will increase honour for him'.

29:24.note: 'Oaths are laid on him' for 'he hears the curse'; plus.

30:1.note: 'Who received prophecy' for 'the oracle'; 'prevailed in strength' from 'the man ... Ucal'; Ithiel once.

30:2.note: 'My mind is lacking' for 'I am brutish'; 'than man' omitted.

30:3.note: Verbs 'learn' and 'know' interchanged; plus second negation.

30:8.note: 'Remove from me' fronted; 'give me' for 'feed me'.

30:9.note: 'Swear by the name' for 'seize the name'.

30:14.note: Plus 'are'; 'the evil' for 'the needy' among men.

30:17.note: 'Old age of his mother' for 'obedience to mother'.

30:27.note: 'Gather together as one' for 'go out in ranks'.

30:30.note: 'Lion's whelp' for ליש; plus copula, 'all', 'and does not fear', final 'beasts'.

30:31.note: Free: 'cock strutting among hens, goat leading the flock, king speaking among the peoples'.

30:32.note: Free: 'do not desire (exaltation) lest you be disgraced (נבלת), and do not stretch your hand to your mouth'; conditionals recast as prohibitions; final word plus.

30:33.note: Plus 'your hand upon', 'so'; 'if you press the nose'.

31:1.note: 'Prophet' for 'oracle'; plus 'and she said to him'.

31:3.note: 'To the food of kings' for 'to those who destroy kings'.

31:4.note: 'Beware of kings who drink wine'; ketiv/qere 'where' not rendered.

31:8.note: 'With a word of truth' for 'for the dumb'; 'judge' for 'cause'; 'sons of iniquity' for 'those passing away'.

31:10.note: Expanded: 'precious is she more than good stones, which have no equal'.

31:27.note: 'The ways of her house are revealed'.
